content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently underestimate price spikes in bullish sentiment periods.", "Model forecasts show persistent lag in capturing sharp upward moves triggered by strong sentiment.", "Sentiment signals with high positive values correlate with forecast overshoots in subsequent periods.", "Models exhibit mean-reversion bias when sentiment turns negative, leading to premature price corrections.", "Forecast accuracy declines when sentiment is volatile or mixed, especially near price extremes.", "High sentiment positivity followed by low forecast growth indicates model underconfidence in upward momentum.", "Models fail to anticipate sudden price reversals when sentiment shifts from bullish to bearish rapidly.", "Forecast bias toward mid-range values suppresses sensitivity to sentiment-driven volatility spikes."]}
